patient.history_present_illness: Ms. Kim is a 35-year-old woman at 28 weeks gestation with generalized epilepsy well-controlled on lamotrigine who is brought by her husband after developing a continuous generalized tonic-clonic seizure that has lasted 10 minutes. She was eating dinner when she suddenly lost consciousness and began convulsing. She had not had a seizure for 2 years before this pregnancy. Her neurologist increased lamotrigine to 300 mg twice daily during pregnancy after noting declining levels. She had a lamotrigine level drawn 2 weeks ago which was 4.2 mcg/mL (low end of therapeutic). She is at 28 weeks gestation. Her blood pressure on the floor was reportedly 162/102 per her husband who used their home monitor.
